# A completed project can stay completed

The harbour archive has correct contact details and an owner for withdrawal requests. There is no proposal to revive it. I can draw on its handover lessons in new work without treating the project as unfinished. [[Exhibition plan]] remains archived. The year-end review should recognize continuing stewardship and leave the launch checklist closed.
